note: Symbol -> art source map. Every paying symbol is a WHOLE owned Lion, identified by the trait it wears (identifiesTrait) but licensed by tokenId. tools/atlas-build/check-licensing.py enforces ownership in CI (spec Sec. 5.3).
rarityMethod: statistical rarity: sum of 1/r_t across a token's traits, r_t = count_t / 10078
